verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a unified `Memory` class that replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity and external memory types. When saving, it uses an LLM to infer scope, categories and importance, and recall is ranked by semantic similarity, recency and importance. The agent docs also state that agents maintain memory of interactions. This covers the core of giving agents long-term memory, though the evidence only implies, rather than spells out, how memory persists across sessions and threads. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the persistent storage backend and of cross-session/cross-thread scoping, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of memory persistence.
